app.title: Mafia Signs
app.subtitle: Interactive gesture dictionary for competitive Sports Mafia
ui.selectPrompt: Select a gesture to see it demonstrated.
ui.noAnimation: No animation available yet for this gesture.
gestures.citizen.name: Citizen
gestures.citizen.description: Thumbs up, or a light touch of something red — shows you are a Citizen.
gestures.mafia.name: Mafia
gestures.mafia.description: Thumbs down, or a light touch of something black — shows you are Mafia or the Don.
gestures.don.name: Don
gestures.don.description: Mime putting a ring onto your finger — identifies the Don.
gestures.sheriff.name: Sheriff
gestures.sheriff.description: Thumb and index finger form a circle (“OK” shape) — identifies the Sheriff.
gestures.me.name: Me
gestures.me.description: Point your index finger at your own chest.
gestures.you.name: You
gestures.you.description: Point your index finger at another player.
gestures.player_number_1.name: Player 1
gestures.player_number_1.description: Hold up 1 finger on one hand to indicate player number 1.
gestures.player_number_2.name: Player 2
gestures.player_number_2.description: Hold up 2 fingers on one hand to indicate player number 2.
gestures.player_number_3.name: Player 3
gestures.player_number_3.description: Hold up 3 fingers on one hand to indicate player number 3.
gestures.player_number_4.name: Player 4
gestures.player_number_4.description: Hold up 4 fingers on one hand to indicate player number 4.
gestures.player_number_5.name: Player 5
gestures.player_number_5.description: Hold up 5 fingers (open hand) to indicate player number 5.
gestures.player_number_6.name: Player 6
gestures.player_number_6.description: Both hands indicate numbers above 5; this animation approximates it as 5 followed by 1.
gestures.player_number_7.name: Player 7
gestures.player_number_7.description: Both hands indicate numbers above 5; this animation approximates it as 5 followed by 2.
gestures.player_number_8.name: Player 8
gestures.player_number_8.description: Both hands indicate numbers above 5; this animation approximates it as 5 followed by 3.
gestures.player_number_9.name: Player 9
gestures.player_number_9.description: Both hands indicate numbers above 5; this animation approximates it as 5 followed by 4.
gestures.player_number_10.name: Player 10
gestures.player_number_10.description: Both hands indicate numbers above 5; this animation approximates it as 5 followed by 5.
gestures.who_is_sheriff.name: Who is Sheriff?
gestures.who_is_sheriff.description: The Sheriff gesture followed by the question gesture — asks who the Sheriff is.
gestures.stop.name: Stop
gestures.stop.description: Both hands (mirrored), flat palm down at the shoulders, a small outward nudge then a halt — signals stop.
gestures.break.name: Break
gestures.break.description: Both palms pressed together, flat, in neutral space — requests a short time-out.
gestures.question_mark.name: Question Mark (What/Why/How/Who?)
gestures.question_mark.description: A hooked index finger, or a question mark traced in the air — a universal question (“what / why / how / who?”), often combined with pointing at a player.
gestures.roof.name: Roof (Protect)
gestures.roof.description: Both hands (mirrored), flat with fingertips of both hands touching to form a peak, then moved to/from the head — the BSL sign for "roof". (Note: “krysha”/“roof” is also Russian criminal slang for mafia protection — included here as that possible reference, not as a confirmed Sports Mafia table gesture.)
gestures.if.name: If
gestures.if.description: Thumb and pinky finger extended, index/middle/ring curled into the fist (a “shaka”-style handshape) — represents the conditional “if”.
gestures.not_sheriff.name: Not Sheriff
gestures.not_sheriff.description: The Sheriff gesture followed by a side-to-side “no” wave — declares a player is not the Sheriff.
gestures.miss.name: Miss
gestures.miss.description: An open hand closes into a pinch with the index finger bent, moved slightly — “miss” / something not hit or not there.
gestures.listen.name: Listen
gestures.listen.description: Both hands (mirrored), fingers spread, drawn in toward the shoulders/ears — “listen”.
gestures.wins.name: Wins
gestures.wins.description: Index and pinky finger extended, middle and ring bent, thumb tucked across the palm — a victory/“wins” sign.
gestures.split.name: Split vote
gestures.split.description: One hand, flat and vertical like a blade, saws down repeatedly through the other, half-open hand — signals a split/tied vote.
gestures.think.name: Think
gestures.think.description: A C-shaped hand near the ear repeatedly opens and closes into a pinch — note: this motion reads visually as chattering/talking, not an obvious “think” gesture (e.g. tapping the temple); flagging in case a different handshape is wanted.
gestures.next.name: Next (After / Then)
gestures.next.description: Both hands (mirrored, alternating), index fingers pointing out, rotating around each other in a continuous circling motion — “next” / move along.
gestures.plus.name: Plus
gestures.plus.description: Both hands, index fingers extended, crossing each other — one vertical, one horizontal — to form a “+” shape.
gestures.minus.name: Minus
gestures.minus.description: One hand, index finger extended horizontally — a flat “−” shape.
gestures.speak.name: Speak
gestures.speak.description: An open hand repeatedly closes into a pinch in front of the body (not at the head, unlike “Think”) — a talking motion.
gestures.kill_player_1.name: Kill Player 1
gestures.kill_player_1.description: Shows player number 1, then the same fingers curl into a repeated hook/claw motion — signals a night kill on that player.
gestures.kill_player_2.name: Kill Player 2
gestures.kill_player_2.description: Shows player number 2, then the same fingers curl into a repeated hook/claw motion — signals a night kill on that player.

gestures.shot.name: Shot
gestures.shot.description: Index and middle finger extended like a gun barrel, thumb across, held at the head — then the fingers curl into a repeated hook/trigger motion — signals the night kill.
gestures.check_player_1.name: Check Player 1
gestures.check_player_1.description: Shows player number 1, then the hooked-finger question gesture — asks about / checks that player.
gestures.kickout_player_1.name: Kick Out Player 1
gestures.kickout_player_1.description: Shows player number 1, then a fist with thumb up is placed onto the other, flat horizontal hand — votes to eliminate that player.

gestures.nominate.name: Nominate
gestures.nominate.description: First shows a player number (like “Player 1”), then a closed fist with thumb up is placed onto the other, flat horizontal hand — proposes that player for voting.
gestures.secret_sheriff.name: Secret Sheriff
gestures.secret_sheriff.description: Just a wink — no hand gesture at all. A discreet, hands-free way for the Sheriff to signal themselves.
gestures.foul.name: Foul
gestures.foul.description: Index finger traces a checkmark-like motion (`hamseqbegin`/`hamseqend`: a short stroke down-right, then a longer stroke up-right) — marks a rule violation.
gestures.reveal.name: Reveal (Open Up / Play As)
gestures.reveal.description: Both flat hands stacked on top of each other like a closed book, then the top hand rotates open while the bottom hand stays put — reveals your role.
